verticalFaqs.question: How does Chiefy handle weather cancellation emails?
verticalFaqs.answer: Chiefy learns your cancellation and rebooking policies. When you cancel a flight due to weather, it can draft personalized rescheduling emails to every affected passenger — with your policy, available dates, and your tone. You review and send. What used to take an hour of individual replies takes minutes.

verticalFaqs.question: Can Chiefy handle the 'will we fly tomorrow?' emails that flood in every evening?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes — this is one of the most common emails balloon operators tell us about. Chiefy learns your weather policies and drafts reassuring replies that explain your decision process, when you'll make the final call, and what to expect. Once you confirm the go/no-go in the morning, it can draft updates to everyone on the manifest.
